#include <vector>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

int span(const std::vector<int>& shts, int start, int time) {
    int i = 1;
    while (start + i < static_cast<int>(shts.size()) && shts[start + i] - shts[start] <= time) {
        ++i;
    }
    return i;
}

int main() {
    std::vector<int> shts;
    int qtty, ts;
    std::cin >> qtty;
    shts.reserve(qtty);
    for (int i = 0; i < qtty; ++i) {
        int aux;
        std::cin >> aux;
        shts.push_back(aux);
    }
    std::cin >> ts;
    std::sort(shts.begin(), shts.end());
    int maxspan = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(shts.size()); ++i) {
        int aux = span(shts, i, ts);

    }
    std::cout << maxspan << '\n';
